passages.heading: Join the Team
passages.text: Get involved! Ryan is looking for people who want to help by placing yard signs, knocking on doors, making calls or just attending events. If that’s you, sign up below.

passages.heading: Welcome to the team!
passages.text: Keep an eye on your inbox for campaign updates and ways to get involved.

passages.heading: I’m Ryan Elijah, and I’m running for Congress in Florida’s District 7.
passages.text: For the past 14 years Ryan Elijah has been a very visible part of the community — building strong bonds with area leaders, giving him a unique position to bring your concerns and needs to the right people at the highest levels.

passages.heading: Meet Ryan Elijah
passages.text: A message from Ryan to the families of Seminole and Volusia counties.

passages.heading: Faith, family, and Central Florida.
passages.text: Ryan and his wife, Tasha, have raised their two boys in Seminole County. As a long-time Florida resident of 20 years — 14 of them in District 7 — he is committed to fighting for conservative Florida values.

passages.heading: Faith, family, and Central Florida.
passages.text: Family is the foundation of our strong communities in Central Florida. Ryan is active in his church and believes in protecting family values.

passages.heading: Endorsements
passages.text: Ryan has earned the support of Florida’s governor, both of the district’s sheriffs, and members of Florida’s congressional delegation.

passages.heading: Key Objectives
passages.text: Focused on Florida and supporting a conservative agenda.

passages.heading: Affordability & Economy
passages.text: Congress must continue driving down costs for American families by keeping taxes low and achieving American energy independence.

passages.heading: Healthcare
passages.text: The United States must continue to lead the world in medical innovation. The federal government can do more to lower healthcare costs.

passages.heading: Consumer Protection
passages.text: Floridians lose hundreds of millions of dollars to fraud every year. Ryan spent years fighting for consumers and recovering money for victims.

passages.heading: Beach Protection
passages.text: Volusia County’s beaches drive a $4.3 billion economy and serve as our first line of defense against storms.

passages.heading: Education
passages.text: Ryan champions parental rights and school choice, empowering families to make the best decisions for their kids and have transparency on curriculum.

passages.heading: The Military & Veterans
passages.text: Ryan comes from a military family, with both his father and grandfather having served.

passages.heading: Law Enforcement
passages.text: Ryan is a strong defender of law enforcement and deeply understands the daily challenges officers face.

passages.heading: Illegal Immigration
passages.text: America is a nation built by immigrants, however we must enforce the rule of law.

passages.heading: Voter Action Center
passages.text: Florida’s 7th District covers all of Seminole County and southern Volusia County. Here’s everything you need to cast your ballot for Ryan.

passages.heading: Vote by Mail
passages.text: Request your ballot from your county Supervisor of Elections, then return it by mail or to a secure drop-off location. Ballots must be received by 7:00 p.m. on Election Day — postmarks don’t count, so mail early.

passages.heading: Vote Early
passages.text: Skip the Election Day lines and vote in person at any early-voting site in your county. Dates, hours, and locations are set by each county Supervisor of Elections — confirm before you go.

passages.heading: Vote on Election Day
passages.text: Polls are open 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Find your assigned precinct and polling place before you head out to vote for Ryan.

passages.heading: Vote on Election Day
passages.text: Not sure if you’re registered, or if you live in Congressional District 7? Check your registration status with the Florida Division of Elections.

passages.text: See Ryan’s television ad, and hear from Ryan on Newsmax after winning the Republican primary.

passages.text: Show your support across Seminole and Volusia counties — request a Ryan Elijah yard sign and a volunteer will get one to you.

passages.heading: Key Objectives
passages.text: As a public figure, Ryan Elijah has been immersed in the community and has heard your concerns. Once elected, he will bring them to those who can help get them addressed.

passages.heading: Affordability & Economy
passages.text: Congress must continue driving down costs for American families by keeping taxes low and achieving American energy independence. Lower gas prices are critical to our economy because they reduce costs for families, businesses, and everything we buy.

passages.heading: Affordability & Economy
passages.text: It’s past time to put a stop to out of control government spending that acts to drive up everyday costs for American families and our national debt.

passages.heading: Affordability & Economy
passages.text: Ryan understands that burdensome federal regulations will slow job creation and economic growth.

passages.heading: Affordability & Economy
passages.text: By unleashing the world’s best economy through lower taxes, less regulation, and smart growth, we will make America more affordable and prosperous for millions of Americans.

passages.heading: Healthcare
passages.text: Ryan supports solutions that deliver affordable, patient-centered healthcare options. He also believes healthcare costs can be reduced by providing individuals with tax benefits, such as expanded Health Savings Accounts.

passages.heading: Healthcare
passages.text: Additionally, Ryan supports greater transparency in the system, including requirements for clear pricing from hospitals, insurers, and other providers.

passages.heading: Consumer Protection
passages.text: Floridians lose hundreds of millions of dollars to fraud every year. During his television career, Ryan spent years fighting for consumers—taking on complex federal cases and recovering thousands of dollars for victims.

passages.heading: Consumer Protection
passages.text: He will support strong consumer-protection legislation and aggressively pursue those who prey on Floridians, especially our most vulnerable senior citizens.

passages.heading: Beach Protection
passages.text: Volusia County’s beaches drive a $4.3 billion economy and serve as our first line of defense against storms. Hurricanes Ian and Nicole severely damaged our shoreline.

passages.heading: Beach Protection
passages.text: Ryan will prioritize working with federal agencies to secure long-term beach nourishment and storm-damage reduction projects.

passages.heading: Education
passages.text: Ryan will strongly support our schools. His boys were educated in both public and private schools. He believes both are critical to our children’s success and our community’s future.

passages.heading: Education
passages.text: That’s why he champions parental rights and school choice, empowering families to make the best decisions for their kids and have transparency on curriculum.

passages.heading: Education
passages.text: Federal funding is important for the district, with the most recent audit showing Seminole County’s budget is comprised of nearly 14% federal funding, while Volusia County is closer to 20%. (National Center for Education Statistics, 2022/23 school year)

passages.heading: Education
passages.text: We must protect local control and ensure every dollar serves our students effectively.

passages.heading: Faith, Family and Life
passages.text: As your representative, he will champion policies that support parents, protect children, and keep families united and strong.

passages.heading: Faith, Family and Life
passages.text: Ryan is pro-life and believes every life is a sacred gift from God.

passages.heading: The Military & Veterans
passages.text: We must ensure that the U.S. military remains the strongest and best-equipped fighting force in the world, backed by the most advanced technology.

passages.heading: The Military & Veterans
passages.text: We must also guarantee that our veterans receive the best possible care after their service to our nation.

passages.heading: Law Enforcement
passages.text: Ryan is a strong defender of law enforcement and deeply understands the daily challenges officers face. He will strongly support legislation that protects law enforcement, including tougher penalties for assaulting or shooting officers.

passages.heading: Law Enforcement
passages.text: He is a staunch supporter of the Second Amendment and has earned an “A” rating with the NRA.

passages.heading: Law Enforcement
passages.text: Ryan has received multiple honors for his outstanding support of law enforcement.

passages.heading: Illegal Immigration
passages.text: We must continue to secure our borders and oppose any measures that weaken enforcement or prioritize non-citizens over American safety.

passages.heading: Illegal Immigration
passages.text: Ryan will work with local law enforcement to stop the flood of illegal drugs that damage our Central Florida communities.

passages.heading: Illegal Immigration
passages.text: He strongly supports the Save America Act, which ensures only American citizens can vote in our elections — because citizenship must matter.

passages.heading: Focused on Florida.
passages.text: Join the team working to send Ryan Elijah to Congress for Seminole and Volusia counties.

passages.heading: I’m Ryan Elijah, and I’m running for Congress in Florida’s District 7.
passages.text: Ryan and his wife, Tasha, have raised their two boys in Seminole County and, as a long-time Florida resident of 20 years — 14 of them in District 7 — he is committed to fighting for conservative Florida values.

passages.heading: I’m Ryan Elijah, and I’m running for Congress in Florida’s District 7.
passages.text: Ryan is an Emmy-winning news anchor, having hosted the popular weekly show Orlando Matters , which provided viewers direct access to elected officials — from members of Congress to the President of the United States.

passages.heading: I’m Ryan Elijah, and I’m running for Congress in Florida’s District 7.
passages.text: Ryan has always been involved with the community. During his broadcasting career, he created a consumer advocacy segment that returned thousands of dollars to residents in need. The segment frequently tackled complex federal issues, including Social Security disability benefits and consumer protection matters.

passages.heading: I’m Ryan Elijah, and I’m running for Congress in Florida’s District 7.
passages.text: He has served on numerous boards, including the YMCA, a homeowners association, and a Christian school board, where he helped oversee budgets and operations. He was also appointed by Jacksonville Mayor John Delaney to serve on the Mayor’s Council. During that time, Ryan hosted television programming for the Jacksonville Jaguars and worked as a sideline reporter for the Jaguars Radio Network and Fox Sports.

passages.heading: I’m Ryan Elijah, and I’m running for Congress in Florida’s District 7.
passages.text: Ryan is active in his church and around Central Florida. You’ll often find his family at our theme parks or taking a cruise from Port Canaveral. He has great memories from coaching high school basketball and Little League baseball.

passages.heading: Trusted Leadership
passages.text: An Emmy-winning broadcaster Central Florida already knows. Host of the weekly show Orlando Matters , giving viewers direct access to elected officials — from members of Congress to the President of the United States.

passages.heading: Trusted Leadership
passages.text: A consumer advocate who delivered results. His consumer advocacy segment returned thousands of dollars to residents in need and tackled complex federal issues, including Social Security disability benefits and consumer protection matters.

passages.heading: Trusted Leadership
passages.text: A community board veteran. Service on the YMCA, a homeowners association, and a Christian school board, overseeing budgets and operations — plus an appointment by Jacksonville Mayor John Delaney to the Mayor’s Council.

passages.heading: Trusted Leadership
passages.text: A husband, father, and 20-year Floridian. Ryan and his wife, Tasha, raised their two boys in Seminole County, and Ryan is active in his church and across Central Florida.
